text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having pushed herself to the limit across 
the finish line, Mejiro Dober became aware 
of the rapid thumping in her chest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was Mejiro Dober's own fierce 
determination to prove her strength 
through repeated victories and become "the 
new glory of the Mejiro family."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finally found herself, Mejiro Dober 
asks for a rematch against Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The decisive stage is the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup. There, she will defeat Air Groove 
this time around...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, aiming for the Fuchu Umamusume 
Stakes that serves as a trial race, she 
took another step forward alongside Mejiro 
Dober.
